text.p: 3Com Corp said Thursday its fiscal second quarter profit from operations rose a better-than-expected 71 percent on strong sales of its computer networking gear.

3Com, the second biggest networking equipment vendor after Cisco Systems Inc, said profits before acquisition charges surged to $112.2 million, or $0.60 a share, compared with $65.6 million, or $0.37, in the same quarter a year ago.

With a charge of $6.6 million for the acquisition of OnStream Networks Inc during the quarter, 3Com had net income of $105.6 million, or $0.56 a share fully diluted. Net income in last year's second quarter was $16.3 million, or $0.09 a share, with a $69 million charge for the acquisition of Chipcom Corp. Even with the charge, 3Com beat Wall Street consensus forecast of $0.55 a share, according to analyst research firm First Call.

Second-quarter revenue jumped 46 percent to $820.3 million from $563.5 million a year ago, the company said. 3Com makes equipment that handles information flow between computers. The company said strong sales of network components for PCs, routers and hubs fueled its net income in the quarter.
